nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Skill guide instructing AI agents on the Beads issue-tracking workflow: how to take the first step, the preferred route, core CLI commands, what belongs in Beads, and the rules for using it.

nodes.name: openai.yaml
nodes.summary: Agent-interface declaration for the Beads skill under an OpenAI-compatible agent runtime, defining its display name, short description, and default prompt text.

nodes.name: post-checkout
nodes.summary: Git post-checkout hook shim that delegates to `bd hooks run post-checkout`, wrapped with a cross-platform timeout guard (timeout/gtimeout/perl fallback) and graceful no-op when the bd CLI or Beads database isn't available.
nodes.languageNotes: POSIX sh with a portable timeout fallback chain (timeout -> gtimeout -> perl alarm) since not all platforms ship GNU coreutils' timeout.

nodes.name: post-merge
nodes.summary: Git post-merge hook shim that delegates to `bd hooks run post-merge`, wrapped with a cross-platform timeout guard and graceful no-op when the bd CLI or Beads database isn't available.

nodes.name: pre-commit
nodes.summary: Git pre-commit hook shim that delegates to `bd hooks run pre-commit`, wrapped with a cross-platform timeout guard and graceful no-op when the bd CLI or Beads database isn't available.

nodes.name: pre-push
nodes.summary: Git pre-push hook shim that delegates to `bd hooks run pre-push`, wrapped with a cross-platform timeout guard and graceful no-op when the bd CLI or Beads database isn't available.

nodes.name: prepare-commit-msg
nodes.summary: Git prepare-commit-msg hook shim that delegates to `bd hooks run prepare-commit-msg`, wrapped with a cross-platform timeout guard and graceful no-op when the bd CLI or Beads database isn't available.

nodes.name: interactions.jsonl
nodes.summary: JSONL audit log recorded by the Beads issue tracker, capturing field-change events (status transitions with narrative close reasons) for the project's tickets.

nodes.name: issues.jsonl
nodes.summary: JSONL export of the Beads issue database for this project: the parent epic plus its 15 child tickets (Walking Skeleton, Employee CRUD, Department Master Data, Auth/RBAC, Search & Filter, Audit Log, Import/Export, MCP Server, Multi-DB Verification, CI Pipelines, Infra Compose, and follow-up fixes) with full descriptions, acceptance criteria, and close reasons.
nodes.languageNotes: Very few lines but each line is a dense JSON record carrying the full project history/spec — line-count metrics understate its informational weight.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Claude Code settings configuring a SessionStart hook that runs `bd prime --hook-json` to load Beads task-tracking context at the start of each session.

nodes.name: config.toml
nodes.summary: Codex CLI feature-flag configuration enabling the hooks feature so Codex sessions can run the project's Beads hook commands.

nodes.name: hooks.json
nodes.summary: Codex CLI hook configuration wiring SessionStart, PreCompact, PostCompact, and UserPromptSubmit events to `bd codex-hook` commands that load and refresh Beads task context during a Codex session.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Understand-Anything ignore-pattern file (gitignore-style syntax) listing directories/files to exclude from codebase analysis; most entries are commented-out opt-in suggestions covering Dolt DB files, SQLite artifacts, a generated route-tree file, and common test-file conventions across languages.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Root-level instructions for AI coding agents covering non-interactive shell command conventions, the Beads issue-tracker workflow (bd/bv CLI usage, triage, scoping and filtering), agent context profiles, and the session-completion/git-policy protocol for this repo.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Project-level instructions for AI coding agents mirroring the Beads issue-tracking workflow, agent context profiles, and session-completion/git protocol, plus placeholder sections for build/test commands and architecture notes.
